'''Tehan''' is the Ship Captain of ''The [[Victory of Kidron]]''.

== Appearance ==
She is wide and weathered with white hair and incredibly green eyes.

== Activities ==
[[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]] and the rest of her group ride aboard Tehan's vessel as she sails them across the [[Aryth Ocean]] from [[Seanchan]]. She is witness to [[Anath]] giving Tuon a tongue-lashing and clearly can not believe what she is hearing.
